profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: As a graduate from Twin Cities Engineering (TCE), an engineering program that was recently awarded by an MIT report in 2018 as one of the most innovative engineering programs in the world for its project-based learning, I have been given the opportunity to go above and beyond the typical learning experience of a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. TCE took the typical engineering education experience beyond the theoretical textbook, forcing me to complete complex projects of my choosing associated with each course I took, while still completing the same textbook problems and exams associated with the typical Bachelor's experience. Although my focus was in electrical engineering, I found myself integrating software design into my electrical systems education almost 100% of the time. I have utilized AutoCAD Electrical, Or-CAD/Cadence/P-Spice to design and simulate circuits and printed circuit boards (PCBs), developed an augmented reality (AR) app for the Microsoft HoloLens AR headset with Unity, Visual Studios, and C#, to assist in circuit board installation, and developed several programs with C#, VB, NI Test Stand, LabVIEW, MATLAB, Arduino, that interface with data acquisition systems (DAQs)/ programmable logic controllers (PLCs) to monitor and control systems such as renewable energy engine efficiency, switching mode DC-DC boost converter power supplies, and manipulation/automation of data analysis. I have also held an Undergraduate Research Assistant position at Twin Cities Engineering, working on an Xcel Energy Grant for renewable energy. Holding leadership roles multiple times at TCE and 3M, and presenting my work several times at length to important clients, including contracted companies around the Twin Cities, the city of Minneapolis, recruiters and professors, I have gained far more experience than the typical Bachelor in Electrical Engineering and am excited to further apply my experiences on my mission to change the world for the better.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Front End, Back End, Pneumatic, Electrical, Asynchronous software, Air Data Computers, ARINC 429, CAN bus, Pneumatic, Pressure-based systems

positions.title: Avionics Test Engineer
positions.description: Navigation, Communication, and Surveillance (CNS)- Radar, Transponder, DME, GPS and VOR. Developed with C#, Microsoft Visual Studios, VB6, NI TestStand, and LabVIEW. Turbo Atlas, NI PXIe configuration and communication. ARINC 429 encoding and decoding. UDP and TCP/IP ethernet communications. Fiber optic communications. Ground Station Simulator ATC-5000, Spectrum Analyzer, Signal Generator, Oscilloscope, DMM, Power Meter, AC and DC Power Supplies. Astronics switching panels. Thermotron AST-8800 temperature profile ESS testing. Utilize development tools such as Wireshark to analyze data packets for communication verification, GitHub, Subversion, Beyond Compare. Data analysis and presentation.

positions.title: Design Ready Controls Augmented Reality Design Team
positions.description: Utilized the Microsoft HoloLens to improve the circuit board installation process by displaying detailed holographic installation instruction precisely over a circuit board. Implemented Image/Object Recognition to precisely locate holographic content in the physical world, voice commands and "Air Tap" commands for the user to interact with holographic buttons, and detailed CAD models of electrical components displayed precisely over the work surface. Developed with Unity and C# using Microsoft Visual Studios.

positions.title: LabVIEW Controls and HMI Implementation for Engine Characterization
positions.description: Utilized LabVIEW and National Instrument's Data Acquisition (DAQs) units in order to monitor several temperature, pressure, RPM, and torque sensors to calculate and optimize engine operating efficiency. Set up a user interface to monitor engine efficiency in real time. Designed HMI with LabVIEW to monitor sensors graphically and calculate efficiency in real time. Exported data to Excel for records and further analysis. Woodward PID throttle control and MSD Ignition timing also monitored and optimized with this process. I was given the Team Lead role on this project. Funding through Xcel Energy.

company.name: Twin Cities Engineering, Minnesota State University, Mankato

positions.title: OrCAD/Cadence/ P-Spice PCB Design and Simulation
positions.description: Utilized OrCAD/Cadence/P-Spice to design and simulate several different circuit configurations and implement them into a manufacturable Printed Circuit Board (PCB), including an Astable Multivibrator and several Op Amp signal filtering designs (high pass, low pass, band pass filter configurations).

company.name: Twin Cities Engineering via Minnesota State University, Mankato

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Tri-PID-Controlled Thermal Conditioner Design: Utilized Proportional-Integral-Differential (PID) Control and high temperature heat wraps to heat a substance from room temperature to max system limits (200 °C) within 1 inch of entering system while precisely maintaining desired temperature by utilizing three separate instances of PID control for a precise temperature profile throughout system until exit. Electrical fan attached at end of system to cool back to room temperature. 

Engine Efficiency: Designed and conducted an experiment on the Honda EB3000c Generator by monitoring gasoline consumption and power output to electrical load during different loading scenarios from minimum to maximum system power output limits

Minneapolis-St. Paul Airport Air Quality Analysis: Designed and conducted the first experiment of its kind at MSP, 1-mile NW of the airport directly in-line with flight paths by utilizing a TSI Condensation Particle Counter (CPC) and a Nanoscan SMPS Nanoparticle Sizer to monitor airplane emissions of 0-1000nm particle diameters. Data collected non-stop for 7 days straight, analyzed and presented to the city within 1-week of collecting data.

company.name: Twin Cities Engineering, University of Minnesota, Mankato

positions.title: LEGO Mindstorm-Programmed and Stepper Motor-Controlled Tri-Folding Device
positions.description: Programming with LEGO Mindstorm PLC and utilizing Stepper Motors, a device was constructed to fold a piece of paper in a specific tri-folding manner.

positions.title: 3M Cable Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked with design engineers from Austin, Texas on brand new twin axial cable production line, improved product quality, developed and improved new testing methods, improved process efficiency, implemented production monitoring process throughout entire Cable department, trained employees on new processes.

positions.title: Arduino and Servo Motor-Controlled Zero-Degree Turn Radius Vehicle
positions.description: Utilizing two Servo Motors and programming with Arduino, a small vehicle was designed to navigate a programmed path, while enabling the vehicle to turn on a zero-degree radius by manipulating each servo motor separately.
